notes:
Implies centralized or systematic control, often by an authority. Frequently used in political, military, and economic contexts. The word carries connotations of top-down regulation, making it common in discussions of wartime policies and government intervention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {統制|とうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to maintain coordination
- {統制|とうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れている→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: to be well-coordinated
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧{統制|とうせい}: price control
- {統制|とうせい}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: controlled economy
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧{統制|とうせい}: quality control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: management — broader, covering day-to-day administration
- ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: regulation — focuses on rules and restrictions, often legal
- ⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧: control — more technical, used for machines and systems
